notes.title: Creator’s Letter of Release Date Postponement
notes.notes: [p]Regarding the new Cute × Psychological × Rhythm Game, Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis, which was originally scheduled for release on October 30, 2025, [/p][p]We have decided to postpone the release to this winter in order to further improve quality and release the game in the best state possible. [/p][p] [/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who has been eagerly awaiting the release. [/p][p] [/p][p]The entire team will continue to devote ourselves wholeheartedly to development, [/p][p]and we would be truly grateful if you could support us warmly, starting with applying for the Closed Beta Test. [/p][p]--------------------------- [/p][p]■Creator’s Letter [/p][p]Producer / Director / Scenario Writer: [/p][p]WHO YOU (Fuyuki Hayashi) [/p][p][/p][p]Nice to meet you. I’m WHO YOU. [/p][p] [/p][p]“Denpa Songs” are filled with love from the two-dimensional world. [/p][p]“Denpa Songs” have an energy that makes people’s hearts race. [/p][p]For me—an outcast otaku who had no place in reality—the time I spent receiving love from the 2D world through “Denpa Songs” was a moment of salvation that made my dead heart beat again. [/p][p] [/p][p]Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis is a project that began with just two people: myself, who loved “Denpa Songs” and “bishoujo games,” and programmer Yazawa. [/p][p]Back in our student days, we were both part of the same doujin game circle. After more than ten years apart, this is the work we began creating together once again. [/p][p] [/p][p]What started as a small project with just the two of us, [/p][p]through many connections and much support, [/p][p]grew before we knew it—its wishlist count exceeding 160,000— [/p][p]into a title that far more people are anticipating than we had ever imagined. [/p][p] [/p][p]To live up to those expectations, we put in even more effort, [/p][p]developing the game with the support of many additional collaborators. [/p][p]However, we judged that we still need more time—to raise the quality as much as possible—so we have decided to delay the release. [/p][p]I deeply apologize for failing to keep our promise on the release date. [/p][p] [/p][p]The origin of this project goes back nearly 25 years. [/p][p]One night, in a pitch-black, deserted storeroom, a child encountered “Denpa Songs” and felt his dead heart come alive again. That moment of wonder is where it all began. [/p][p]As the planner and director, I am determined not to betray that pure emotion, and with resolve, I will take every possible measure to refine this work. [/p][p] [/p][p]Although the release of the full version will be delayed, [/p][p]through the implementation of the “Closed Beta Test” and other opportunities to let players experience it firsthand and share feedback, we will continue to make steady progress toward completion. [/p][p] [/p][p]It may be shameless to ask this despite the delay, [/p][p]but I would be grateful if you could continue to look forward to Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis. [/p][p]I promise we will deliver wonderful Denpa to you. [/p]
